OOS_protocol.data_window: to be fixed in the registration before any data is read
OOS_protocol.train_test_boundary: later period of the aligned two-venue history

capacity_model.note: two margin accounts must each cover the move; transfer cost not modelled

counterparty: longs on the high-funding venue; venue-specific funding formula, not a person
economic_mechanism: Counterparty: longs on the high-funding venue pay; the long on the low-funding venue receives or pays less. Persists because capital and margin are fragmented across venues and transfers take time; disappears as arbitrageurs move collateral, and is capped by withdrawal friction, venue counterparty risk and different funding clocks and caps.
eligibility_rules: both venues registered order-capable in bot/venues.py (currently only Bybit is)
entry: open opposite perps when the as-of funding gap exceeds a registered threshold
execution_model: two venues, taker, legs not atomic; second venue is outside this repo's order-capable set
exit: gap closes, or either venue's margin buffer falls below a registered floor
hypothesis: The same perpetual pays different funding on two venues; short the higher, long the lower, and the gap exceeds costs.
prospective_protocol: forward observation of the funding gap on both venues; no trading on a venue not qualified by the owner
rejection_conditions: no second order-capable venue is qualified (hard stop: strategy is untradeable by this repo)
gap net of two-venue costs and transfer friction not positive
gap explained by differing funding formulas/caps rather than a persistent imbalance
funding clocks cannot be aligned to the same settlement

required_data.gap: BTC on Binance and Bybit exists; different intervals and no collateral-transfer cost data
required_data.name: funding history for the same symbol on two venues, aligned to settlement clocks

required_data.gap: owner has a Bybit account only; second venue is unqualified (venues.py)
required_data.name: per-venue fees, margin, withdrawal and transfer cost/latency

risk_model: venue default/withdrawal halt; margin on the losing leg during a squeeze; funding clock mismatch
status_note: SPECIFICATION ONLY. Nothing has been tested; this is not a winner. bias_declarations state what the protocol must rule out before any evidence counts, not that it has been ruled out.
